lines.t: Beloved, I ask you
With the soft loving tone of a father
Are you willing to put me first?
First, consider and ask yourselves, do you love me more than these?
Do you love me more than your brothers and sisters?
Do you love me more than your spouse, your children, your family?
And what if your possessions?
Will you give up this life for me, my sons?
Are you moved by me? I tell you the truth
I gave up my life for you without hesitation
Now come and partake of me
Taste and see
That the Lord is good
Yeah
Yeah
Yes, your God is love
And my heart wavers not
Nor do I change
And if I love you as you are
Why do you not come to me
So you may receive of my approval
And share in all these gifts
Which I long to bestow upon you
Gifts of all kinds
With many words
Words of comfort and healing
Of correction and guidance
Understanding which comes
By the knowledge of my love
Therefore my beloved
Draw near and receive
Know me
Seek to please me only
And you shall surely receive all I offer
For truly I was poured out for you
Are you willing to walk in the same?
A vessel set apart, meet for my glory
Thank you.
